name: KIRILL & FRIENDS BERLIN FESTIVAL 2026
description: The inaugural edition of the KIRILL & FRIENDS BERLIN FESTIVAL by director Kirill Serebrennikov marks the 75th anniversary of the Berliner Festspiele with an international cultural ecosystem. The 10-day festival presents stage productions previously celebrated elsewhere—including Ligeti's Le Grand Macabre, LEGENDE, DER SCHNEESTURM, APOCALYPSE TOMORROW, and DIE TRAUER DES DÄMONS—at venues across Berlin including Komische Oper Berlin @ Schillertheater, Deutsches Theater, and St. Matthäuskirche. The programme also features a curated selection of films from Cannes Film Festival sections not yet shown in Berlin, and two artistic workshops developed through an international open call.
